stem:
The number of stores opened by a coffee company can be modeled by the exponential function graphed on the grid, where x is the number of years since 1992.

Based on the graph, which statement does not appear to be true?

options.label: F
options.text: The coffee company had opened 400 stores by the end of 1992.

options.label: G
options.text: The coffee company opened 100 stores in one year.

options.label: H
options.text: Every year the number of stores the coffee company opened increased by 25%.

options.label: J
options.text: Since 1992 the coffee company has opened 250 stores each year.

visual_elements: Graph with x-axis labeled 'Number of Years Since 1992' ranging from 0 to 10 and y-axis labeled 'Number of Stores' ranging from 0 to 2400, showing an exponential curve starting near 400 when x=0 and rising steeply as x increases.
